title: Clause evaluation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $C$ be a term of literals on $n$ coordinates, and let $x$ be a sign vector of length $n$. The clause value is $-1$ if at least one literal in $C$ evaluates to $-1$ at $x$, and is $1$ otherwise.
